title: Resolution of differing opinions
description: procedure to resolve differing opinions among Bench members

steps.step: Bench members state the point or points on which they differ
Bench members make a reference to the President
President either hears the point or points himself or refers the case for hearing on such point or points by one or more of the other members
Point or points are decided according to the opinion of the majority of the members who have heard the case, including those who first heard it
President either hears the point or points himself or refers the case for hearing by one or more other members
President or other member gives opinion on the point or points so referred within two months from the date of reference
